fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/seo/ListingPages/SeoStructure.cy.js#SEO structure - ListingPages [newTrucks] [hi] — Find New Trucks TC-SEOS-01: heading structure on Find New Trucks [hi] matches the stored snapshot
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SEOS-01
**Title:** Heading structure on Find New Trucks [hi] matches the stored snapshot
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open Find New Trucks (hi) and compare live SEO headings with the snapshot. Allure and artifacts/seo-structure-report.xlsx show expected vs actual so a changed heading can be copied into test data after it is confirmed.

**Expected Result:**
Every stored heading on Find New Trucks (hi) is still present with the same tag. Extra or missing headings fail the check; order on the page may differ.

**Steps:**
1. Open Find New Trucks (hi)
2. Expand Read More if the About block is collapsed
3. Compare live headings with the stored snapshot
